payload.finding: render(palette,textures,q,qd,mood,epq,**kwargs) reads variable coherence although coherence is neither a declared parameter nor initialized locally. In ordinary isolated execution this is a deterministic NameError; ambient-global injection would instead make the dependency hidden and non-local.
payload.oracle: Plugin/module interfaces must declare every state/input dependency. Missing required state must fail visibly at validation/lowering or explicit runtime boundary; implementations may not silently consume undeclared ambient globals.
tests: reject or explicitly bind undeclared free-variable state dependencies
same module executed in isolated and integrated contexts must not change validity due only to ambient globals
Clay lowering must preserve explicit state provenance and dependency identity
payload.reason_no_credit: Small historical bug becomes a regression fixture, not an independent current implementation contribution.
